question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi is a body working under which of the following ministries of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Culture.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sangeet Natak Akademi is a body working under the Ministry of Culture.**
 
• The** first national academy of the arts was **set up by the **Republic of India.**
 
• It was created by a** resolution of the** **Ministry of Education, Government of India, dated 31 May 1952, which was notified in the Gazette of India of June 1952.**
 
• One of the main recommendations of the** National Conference on Dance, Drama, and Music, held in New Delhi in 1951.**
 
• Recognizes eight classical dances **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Sattriya, Manipuri and Mohiniyattam.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Culture is the Indian government ministry charged with the **preservation and promotion of the art and culture of India**.
 
• **G. Kishan Reddy** is the current Minister of Culture. 
 
• The government has established the** National Mission on Libraries India under this ministry.**
